description: PXE server that boots ISO files over the network for OS installation (Free Edition).
notes: iVentoy Free Edition: personal, non-commercial use only, max 20 PXE clients, no ARM64/LoongArch64 client support (Pro Edition is paid).
Running iVentoy needs Administrator rights (DHCP 67/69/4011 and TFTP ports): launch the shortcut as administrator, or run `sudo iVentoy_64.exe` from a shell.
Put your ISO files in the persisted iso folder (`scoop prefix iventoy\iso`); the web UI listens on http://127.0.0.1:26000 after you start the service.
The archive ships its own updater (lib\update.exe). Turn that off and use `scoop update iventoy` so files stay Scoop-managed.
Server settings (NIC, IP pool) are stored in data\config.dat and are replaced on update: re-select them in the web UI after upgrading.
To run as a Windows service, configure it once in the web UI, then run InstallService.bat as administrator from `scoop prefix iventoy`.
